reject: generic seller listing/manage numbers (including lowercase seller slugs)

findings.observation: Two fixed-key facts align by direct label/value meaning; 450ml is visible in the RA title but not as a structured RA attribute. No manual capacity threshold was used.
Country conflicts. Treat fixed country fields as a disagreement/abstention signal; the same model-token rule rejects o2-037 as a retailer listing slug.
AU fixed specs name component facts while RA attributes expose only overall count/weight; there is no fixed-key component-level comparison here.

recommendation: Implement a conservative exact manufacturer-model rule over explicit RA manufacturer-model attributes and AU title/comment text. Accept code-shaped values with retained punctuation/suffix and reject bare numeric identifiers and seller-like slugs. Count pair 24 separately or at lower confidence when the only occurrence is in an AU asset path; if the rule is restricted to visible prose, the strong observed coverage is 2/31 pairs. Fixed-spec comparisons should use only a small explicit label map, surface direct conflicts such as pair 26 country, and abstain where source grains differ.
